description: This source file implements the PruneEmptyCases function, which traverses and modifies an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to remove empty switch cases and prune unnecessary code blocks.

classes.name: PruneEmptyCasesTraverser
classes.description: A private class inheriting from TIntermTraverser that implements the logic to traverse and prune empty switch cases.

methods.name: AreEmptyBlocks
methods.description: Checks if all statements in a sequence are empty blocks or no-op statements.

methods.name: IsEmptyBlock
methods.description: Determines if a node is an empty block or a non-contributing node.

methods.name: PruneEmptyCasesTraverser::apply
methods.description: Static method to apply the traversal and pruning process on the AST.

methods.name: PruneEmptyCasesTraverser::visitSwitch
methods.description: Overrides the visitSwitch method to identify and prune empty switch cases.
